constraints: Company is a constrained WM-ORG-001 view; it MUST reference one existing organization subject and MUST NOT create, merge or reassign organization identity.

Organization resolution MUST use a persisted resolution record with candidate identifiers, evidence, rule version, decision, authority, valid time and knowledge time; names, brands, sites and statistical group numbers are never sufficient identity keys.
Canonical identifiers and tombstones are never reassigned; same names, co-equal names and rebranding preserve distinct or continuing identities according to explicit evidence.
Legal personality, registration, ownership shares and beneficial ownership remain sibling master facts; the profile records applicability references and never copies or overrides them.

GroupPerimeter is a purpose-qualified WM-ORG-012 relationship graph whose endpoints are WM-ORG-001 actors; BusinessPerimeter may additionally reference units, teams or branches only through their own model identities and typed routing rules.

Every perimeter has a stable perimeter id, kind-code-list version, purpose, specification version, jurisdiction when applicable, validity interval, knowledge interval, source policy, owner and supersession link.

Every membership assertion carries endpoint roles, direct-or-derived status, valid time, knowledge time, inclusion date, basis, evidence, claimant authority, relationship steward, disclosure policy, dispute state and absence semantics.

Management, consolidation, ownership-control, official statistical, derived statistical, franchise and alliance graphs remain independent; no union, equivalence or cross-kind transitivity is implicit.

Self-links are rejected; cycles, multiplicity, parent cardinality and transitivity are governed per kind and rule version; every derived edge pins its direct inputs and never contaminates asserted facts.

Consolidation thresholds are jurisdiction-, policy- and effective-date-qualified. HR/ERP sources may inform management views only and never establish consolidation, ownership-control or official statistical membership.
Official statistical membership is kept separate from derived statistical grouping, and reporting exceptions remain mastered by WM-ORG-001.

Perimeter specifications and relationship assertions are append-only revisions. Corrections supersede records; relationship closure differs from evidence retirement and cannot rewrite a past materialization.

Replay uses one profile knowledge-time axis mapped explicitly to each base field. Materializations pin all input ids/digests, source revisions, specification/rule/policy versions, code-list version, valid-time query, knowledge-time query and output digest.

Retention or erasure may redact payloads but preserves authorized tombstones, digests, reason codes and replay status inputs-redacted; withheld, unknown, not-reported, expired and explicit non-existence are distinct.

WM-ORG-012 exclusively masters relationship facts. WM-ORG-001 retains endpoint identity, names, succession, official statistical alignment, reporting exceptions and derived indexes; the profile grants no change authority over member facts.

Disclosure and source-license restrictions dominate export. A projection preserves tombstones and weakest corroboration, exposes no inferred member attributes and never converts absence into non-existence.
Relationship fact steward, perimeter-specification owner and materialized-view custodian are distinct roles; a named profile owner governs this profile and its code lists.

A true group actor is represented only as an existing or separately resolved WM-ORG-001 instance after independent identifier, independent capacity or obligations and external mastership are all evidenced; a statistical group number alone is insufficient.
BrandAssociation is a qualified relationship or name-form assertion and never a Company, group identity or runtime identifier.

Publication is refused while fixturesExecuted is false, either base is non-canonical, inherited holds remain open, the parent/reference seam is unapproved, normative pins drift, or executable carrier requirements are unmet.

inheritedBaseHolds.hold: Source and live-version verification is incomplete and must be run before publication: every accepted source URL must be re-fetched and its version pin confirmed. The two providers cite different GLEIF URL paths for the same two documents (LEI-CDF 3.1 under /common-data-file-format/current-versions/ versus /common-data-file-format/, and the ELF list under /code-lists/ versus the bare path), so at least one variant in each pair is stale or a redirect and the canonical form must be established.

Multi-profile domain validation has not been performed. The structure must be exercised against at least six distinct profiles before publication: a registered company with an LEI, an unregistered informal collective with no scheme identifier, an international branch holding its own LEI without separate legal personality, a fund with an umbrella and management relationship, a resident government entity formed by statute, and a sole proprietor whose legal person is a natural person. Coverage claims are provisional until each profile is walked end to end.

The EUID and BRIS provisions carried by Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/1042 were surfaced from indexed EUR-Lex text rather than a full-text read, by the base provider's own admission. The EUID-specific data element must be treated as provisional and verified against the Official Journal before any normative reliance.

FATF Recommendations 24 and 25 were unreachable (HTTP 403), so the beneficial-ownership structure rests on BODS at authority tier 2 rather than on the intergovernmental requirement it implements. The ownership layer must be re-grounded before it is published as an authority-backed structure.

The base naming finding asks which single name form is the legal name, which is wrong for multilingual jurisdictions where RegOrg and SEMIC CBV make legalName a repeatable language-tagged literal with several co-equal legal names. The naming layer must be reframed to admit multiple co-equal legal names, with the RegOrg prohibition on storing translations in alternative-name fields, before that layer is published as normative.

ISO 17442-1:2020 and ISO 20275 were cited from standards-catalogue landing pages, not normative text. Any statement in the synthesized model that reads as a conformance or eligibility rule derived from those standards must be marked alignment-only until the normative text is obtained.

ISO 5009 is carried by the base as a tier-1 primary source for official organizational roles while the other provider records it as discovered but not fetched. The official-roles finding's specific claims (role counts, jurisdiction coverage, tie to ELF, exclusion of internal functional titles) must be confirmed against the fetched code list before publication.
